title: Pikes Peak and Garden of the Gods Small Group Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Guests Ages 8+ No children under 8 unless it has been authorized by tour operator.
Pikes Peak Highway is open year round. In case the summit is not accessible due to weather conditions, constrictions, and other road closures we will drive to the highest point possible.
policies: **LUNCH & LIGHT SNACKS INCLUDED** - This tour comes with a choice of a Turkey + Swiss, Turkey + Pepper Jack, Roast Beef + Provolone, Turkey & Roast Beef (no cheese), Tuna Salad, Gluten-Free Salad, Gluten-Free Bar and Fruit. Please send us a message via Viator/Tripadvisor with your lunch preference for all travelers in your group otherwise if we don't hear from you, a turkey sandwich will be provided..
**MEETING LOCATION** - Colorado Convention Center, in front of Blue Bear sculpture
This experience requires a minimum number of travelers. If it’s canceled because the minimum isn’t met, you’ll be offered a different date/experience or a full refund.
Clothing layers for cooler temperatures and inclement weather.
For nearby Convention Center Parking visit spothero website and type in the Convention Center address 700 14th St
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This tour stands out by combining two of Colorado’s most iconic landscapes in one seamless, professionally guided experience. Explore the towering red rock formations of Garden of the Gods and ascend to the summit of Pikes Peak at 14,115 feet—all in a single day.

With expert storytelling, curated scenic stops, and a comfortable small-group setting, guests experience dramatic elevation changes, panoramic views, and Colorado’s natural beauty without the stress of planning or driving. It’s a memorable, efficient way to experience the best of the Front Range.
